basis: Skin mastocytosis, hearing loss and microcephaly define syndrome; optic atrophy 80-99%; scoliosis 2/3 and contractures omitted at the four-axis cap.

decisions.haematologic: none: mastocytosis is cutaneous; blood-cell, marrow or coagulation dysfunction is not established.
decisions.neurologic: primary: microcephaly is defining and present in 3/3; intellectual disability occurs in 2/3.
decisions.ocular: involved: optic atrophy is annotated in 80-99% and represents direct visual-system damage.

basis: Autoinflammation/immunodeficiency with neutrophilic skin disease; thrombocytopenia 2/2. Seizure in 1/2 does not establish persistent CNS damage.

decisions.neurologic: none: seizure occurs in 1/2, but direct CNS injury or persistent neurologic dysfunction is not established.

basis: Neuroendocrine tumor arising in sympathetic paraganglia or adrenal medulla; catecholamine-related hypertension alone does not establish direct cardiovascular injury.

decisions.cardiovascular: none: hypertension is a common secretory effect; direct cardiovascular injury in at least 30% is not established.

basis: B-cell deficiency, distal limb and urinary malformations define syndrome. ID/microcephaly are isolated reports; recurrent infections are separate diseases.

decisions.neurologic: none: ID and microcephaly each occur in one assessed patient within a larger cohort; intrinsic neurologic involvement in at least 30% is unestablished.

basis: LGI1-mediated autoimmune limbic encephalitis; obstinate SIADH-associated hyponatremia occurs in ~50-60%, representing intrinsic electrolyte dysfunction.

decisions.metabolic_endocrine: involved: obstinate disease-associated hyponatremia occurs in ~50-60%; this axis explicitly covers electrolyte disorders without requiring gland destruction.

basis: Respiratory-chain defect; neuropathy/developmental impairment and COX-negative muscle fibers with exercise intolerance each reported in 1/1 patient.

decisions.musculoskeletal: involved: COX-negative muscle fibers plus exercise intolerance in 1/1 support clinically consequential muscle dysfunction, beyond an isolated enzyme result.

basis: Urinary reflux/collecting-system defects define disease. Hypermobility in 2/2 lacks documented tissue injury or functional loss; UTIs are separate infections.

decisions.musculoskeletal: none: joint hypermobility in 2/2 does not by itself establish damaging joint disease or impaired locomotor function.

basis: Myopathy with defining eyelid/extraocular dysfunction: ptosis 12/12, ophthalmoplegia 11/12; bulbar weakness is myopathic.

decisions.ocular: primary: eyelid and extraocular dysfunction are defining features of oculopharyngodistal myopathy; ptosis 12/12 and ophthalmoplegia 11/12.

basis: Ichthyosis, hepatic enlargement and cerebellar degeneration define syndrome. Splenomegaly (80-99%) lacks evidence of impaired splenic blood function.

decisions.haematologic: none: splenomegaly is defining and occurs in 80-99%, but enlargement alone does not establish impaired splenic blood function or hematologic damage.

basis: Capillary barrier failure; pancreatitis (30-79%) is a separate disease; pulmonary edema often follows resuscitation; renal injury occurs in 5-29%.

decisions.gastrointestinal: none: pancreatitis is annotated in 30-79%, but is a separately diagnosed disease; direct pancreatic damage intrinsic to capillary leak is not established.
